name: Formula Pro TLR S-Light (Gen 6)

origin.basis: Inoue Rubber Co., Ltd. (IRC Tire) was founded in 1926 in Japan and has its head office in Nagoya (IRC about page).

manufacturing.basis: IRC does not state where this tire is made.

positioning: IRC's sixth-generation lightweight tubeless-ready race tire with a dual compound and RBCC2 tread.
hookless_note: IRC lists a hookless pressure range for every size, capped at 73 psi.

availability.note: IRC's US site sends buyers to local bike shops or the Pure Gravel web store; no price recorded. Mainland China and European availability not verified.

caveats: No independent lab test of the Gen 6 S-Light found; the lab-tested Formula Pro RBCC is a different tire.

image.shown: Gen 6 Formula Pro TLR S-Light as pictured on IRC's product page, with IRC's model-name and 'new' graphics.
image.alt: IRC Formula Pro TLR S-Light road tire with the model name printed beside it

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.
